$comment: A web portal's store assets, as data for `umm-dev store`. Another storefront is another file shaped like this one: assets keyed by id, each an image or a video with the checks it must pass. docs/media.md has the schema.
name: CrazyGames
rules: Covers: no border, no text but the title, no icons or store logos, nothing blurry; the three alike.
Videos: open on the static cover, no black or logo transitions, no black bars, no cursor, no fast-forward, no text such as Play now.
Leave the landscape cover's top corner clear: the portal may lay a badge there.
